profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer for Xbox Research
profile.summary:
I am a software and platform engineer who applies AI to ship reliable systems and products.

AI is changing where engineering judgment matters. Producing code is becoming cheaper; defining intent, shaping architecture, supplying the right context, validating behavior, and operating systems safely are becoming more important. Those are the problems I have spent my career solving.

Across more than a decade at Microsoft, I have built and modernized customer-facing services, distributed cloud platforms, self-service operational tools, data pipelines, and developer infrastructure. I am an end-to-end builder who can move from an ambiguous problem through architecture, implementation, data and infrastructure, testing, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.

My recent work extends that foundation into applied AI: creating reusable AI-assisted engineering tools, connecting agent workflows to governed data through MCP-style integrations, enabling researcher-built applications, and helping teams define practical boundaries for AI-native development. I focus on the engineering around AI that determines whether it succeeds in production: context, tools, permissions, data quality, evaluation, telemetry, human review, security, and failure recovery.

I stay hands-on while creating leverage across teams. I turn manual or engineer-dependent workflows into secure self-service platforms; build shared deployment, monitoring, and diagnostic patterns; lead architecture and code reviews; and mentor engineers through service ownership. My background in reliability, security, live-site operations, and platform modernization helps me evaluate AI-generated systems rather than simply generate more code.

I am interested in Staff or Principal roles building applied AI systems, agent and developer platforms, AI-enabled products, or the cloud and data foundations that make them reliable.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Led architecture and delivery across cloud platforms, data systems, developer tooling, and customer-facing services from ambiguous requirements through launch and operational ownership.
- Created reusable AI-assisted engineering tools for infrastructure deployment, diagnostics, data ingestion, and repeatable development workflows.
- Helped define practical operating patterns for agent workflows and researcher-built applications, including bounded scope, governed data access, human review, and production ownership.
- Enabled agent and MCP-style access to internal data capabilities while applying established platform disciplines around permissions, security, observability, and maintainability.
- Built real-time ingestion, privacy-aware analytics foundations, and automated reporting that made trusted data more accessible to researchers and downstream applications.
- Modernized identity, secrets, SDKs, deployment, telemetry, and network controls across established cloud services and dozens of resources.
- Built reusable infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, runbook, and service-definition patterns that improved consistency and operational readiness across workstreams.
- Mentored engineers through architecture, implementation, code review, debugging, and service ownership while remaining active in hands-on delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Led development of a cloud feedback platform that replaced a legacy system, converted bespoke engineering workflows into configuration, and supported roughly a dozen partner teams.
- Replaced a fragile daily registration workflow with event-driven processing, reducing turnaround from days to seconds in most cases.
- Built self-service portals, diagnostics, recovery tools, and operational context that allowed teams to resolve issues without depending on undocumented expert knowledge.
- Drove infrastructure-as-code adoption, modern telemetry, deployment standardization, geo-reliability improvements, and retirement of legacy services.
- Eliminated recurring service failure modes and improved production control through health dashboards, alerts, incident context, testing, and runbooks.
- Coordinated multi-engineer workstreams, translated ambiguous requirements into executable designs, and reviewed unfamiliar systems across team boundaries.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built console, web, service, and operational capabilities for a large-scale product preview and customer-feedback ecosystem.
- Developed self-service content, reporting, enrollment, and feedback-triage workflows that reduced manual and one-off engineering work.
- Modernized a critical feedback service from a single-machine design to managed infrastructure and strengthened logging, alerting, and on-call readiness.
- Built an extensible operations portal with a substantial automated test suite and close collaboration with operational users.
- Owned production support, incident investigation, service quality, and cross-team integration for customer-facing systems.

positions.title: Active Directory SEDT Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a tool to aide in a previously manual task for Windows Azure Active Directory.
- Designed the client interface and interactions with the supporting web service.
- Built the entire UI using Bootstrap.js and Knockout.js for easy usability

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
CS 2200 Systems and Networks
- Assisted the professor in the instruction and understanding of course material
- Developed and revised projects and homework to challenge the understanding of the students
- Provided one-on-one teaching to students to further learning

positions.title: Research Project Assistant
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a user interface for a data visualization project
- Broke down large packages of information and filtering it through the UI to create more manageable
groups
- Manipulated .pdf, .doc, .xml, and other Document-type files to be visually represented as images

positions.title: Blue Sky Internship
positions.description:
Worked with the Watson Research Team:
- Collaborated on a project to develop new software
- Collected data for the software’s production and testing
